messages:
elaine: Quick sync 11 I'm compiling the release notes for the docs site (whatsnew bullets, changelog entry, migration links, and a short known-issues/caveats). Draft (read-only): https://redwood.internal/docs/release-draft-2026-03

matt: nice. can you list the PRs you want called out so i can tag them for the release label?

elaine: PRs to call out: #5042 (sdk-snippet-refresh), #5051 (migration-paths-update), #5057 (link-redirects), #5060 (streaming-examples). also a tiny docs-only tweak in #5062 for wording.

sophia: skimmed the draft. please keep whatsnew to two very short bullets for the marketing email. i'll trim copy if needed.

elaine: agreed. planning 2 bullets + one-line "known issue" card. current whatsnew draft: 
- Streaming examples: clearer snippets for JS/TS SDKs
- Migration guide: steps to move from legacy endpoints

kevin: heads-up: we need to flag the old /v1/generate deprecation and link to the migration guide. proposed deprecation date: 2026-07-01. include an automated migration snippet link.

elaine: added a one-line deprecation callout with the date and link to the migration document.

ben: small code note: the JS example in #5042 still shows old client API name (createCompletion). new SDK examples should use client.complete(). i'll update the PR but want the whatsnew to reflect the new snippet.

elaine: thanks. replacing snippet in the draft now:
```js
// JS example: completion (new SDK)
const resp = await client.complete({ model: 'redwood-kestrel', prompt: 'Summarize the following:' })
console.log(resp.output_text)
```

sophia: can we also include a one-line workaround for the embeddings + streaming token edge-case? customers will hit it.

elaine: proposed workaround added:
"Workaround: when using embeddings with streaming, set max_tokens to model_limit - 40 to avoid token truncation on some runtimes."

kevin: infra follow-up: redirect for /docs/old-embed -> /docs/embedding-migration is fixed in infra PR #5063. will land to staging in ~15m.

infra-bot: Infra PR #5063 merged to staging. Redirect propagation expected in 10-20 minutes.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs release checklist requires: changelog entry, whatsnew bullet, and a docs reviewer approval. See /docs/release-checklist. Make sure to add the release-note label to merged PRs.

matt: tagging reviewers now: @sophia @ben please review whatsnew bullets + the updated JS snippet. target publish: Thursday EOD.

sophia: on it. i'll sanity-check tone and link hygiene. short bullets look good.

ben: running snippet tests locally. found a lint quirk in #5060 streaming example; i'll push a tiny fix in that PR.

elaine: updated draft link to include whatsnew fragment: https://redwood.internal/docs/release-draft-2026-03?whatsnew (read-only)

matt: quick ask: kevin, can you confirm the redirect actually returns 302 on staging and not a 404? last time we saw a caching issue.

kevin: confirmed on staging: 302 to /docs/embedding-migration. cache TTL updated.

sophia: approved from content side. :thumbsup: I'll leave a short note on the PR approving the whatsnew copy.

ben: smoke-tested snippets (after lint fix) and all good locally. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: docs site deploy started for release/2026-03 (build 1245) :rocket:

deploy-bot: staging deploy completed 11 https://docs.redwood.ai (staging) 1 build 1245

elaine: published to staging and sent to product for sign-off. will cut prod deploy after marketing ack (aiming for 1pm PST).

marketing-bot: Marketing requested a 2-bullet whatsnew for the email. confirmed. provided short blurb and link to relnotes on prod once live.

matt: final step: add release-note label to merged PRs (#5042 #5051 #5057 #5060 #5062). i'll do a final sweep then trigger the prod deploy.

elaine: prod deploy triggered and complete. posted final whatsnew in #marketing and added relnotes link.

marketing-bot: Notified marketing channel with whatsnew blurb and relnotes link (prod).

elaine: closing thread. excellent coordination, short and tidy. thanks everyone.
